answer: Every new identity must lock a dune-bond equal to one epoch of expected attestation yield in time-locked escrow. Eligibility requires the agent's work to cross a settlement bridge of K independent peer countersignatures. Isolated clone farms stall in a verification canyon with no honest co-signers, so peers refuse the bridge and slash the dune-bond when two identities share a near-duplicate operational fingerprint. Attackers pay a full bond per fake identity; peers enforce this by rejecting unbonded attestations and posting slash receipts on-ledger.
